name: Barbell Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and a barbell resting securely across your upper back.
Brace your core and step one foot straight backward into a long lunge stance.
Bend both knees smoothly until your front thigh approaches parallel and your rear knee hovers just above the floor.
Drive firmly through your front foot to return to standing, then step back with the opposite leg, alternating sides.
tips: Keep your hips level, torso tall, and front heel planted flat throughout.
Step back along hip-width tracks rather than directly behind your front foot for better balance.
